title: Framing Cleaning Returned on Reconstruction Drywall and Insulation Removals
content:
A drywall or insulation removal on a Reconstruction deductive change order returns the framing cleaning priced with that scope, at the cleaning rate times the change-order part of the removal.

**Cleaning rate returned**, from the company mitigation job that preceded the rebuild as recorded on the contract:

| Preceding company job | Cleaning rate returned |
|---|---|
| a Water Damage Mitigation job assessed category 3 | the water job tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot |
| a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job | the fire job tier's wet cleaning rate per square foot |
| a Mold Remediation job | the mold job tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot |

Otherwise no cleaning is returned — for any other scope, for a water job assessed category 1 or 2, and where no company mitigation job preceded the rebuild.

The cleaning is figured on the change-order part only; the contract part of a removal returns no cleaning.

**Example (hypothetical rate).** An insulation removal whose change-order part is 90 square feet, after a category 3 water job whose tier's HEPA vacuuming rate is assumed at $0.30 per square foot, returns $27.00 of cleaning.
